questions.text: A company wants to transfer data from their on-premises network to AWS using a rugged, portable edge computing and storage device that weighs less than 5 pounds. Which device fits this description?
questions.why: AWS Snowcone is the smallest member of the AWS Snow Family of edge computing, edge storage, and data transfer devices, weighing only 4.5 lbs (2.1 kg) with 8 Terabytes of usable storage.
questions.priorityNote: retired by AWS

questions.text: A developer needs to discover exactly where performance bottlenecks are occurring in their microservices application by tracing the path of individual requests. Which service provides this tracing?
questions.why: AWS X-Ray helps developers analyze and debug production, distributed applications, such as those built using a microservices architecture, by providing end-to-end tracing of requests.

questions.text: Which AWS managed service provides a secure, fully managed Git-based repository for storing source code?
questions.why: AWS CodeCommit is a fully managed source control service that hosts secure Git-based repositories, making it easy for teams to collaborate on code in a secure and highly scalable ecosystem.
questions.priorityNote: not on the CLF-C02 in-scope list

questions.text: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, the customer is responsible for which of the following?

options.text: Updating the firmware on the physical host servers
Managing the customer data and setting up IAM policies
Disposing of physical hard drives in AWS data centers
Patching the underlying host operating system of Amazon RDS

questions.why: Customers are responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud', which includes configuring IAM, encrypting customer data, patching guest operating systems (on EC2), and securing their networks.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing principle provides discounts when you purchase more capacity, essentially offering lower variable costs at higher scales?

options.text: Tiered pricing (Pay less when you use more)

questions.why: With tiered pricing (like in Amazon S3 or Data Transfer Out), the more volume you use, the less you pay per gigabyte. This translates economies of scale to the customer.

questions.text: A company wants to identify the root cause of an operational issue that recently caused a spike in CPU utilization on their EC2 instances. Which monitoring service aggregates metrics and logs to provide this visibility?
questions.why: Amazon CloudWatch collects and visualizes real-time logs, metrics, and event data in automated dashboards to streamline your infrastructure and application maintenance.

questions.text: Which service acts as a fully managed graph database engine optimized for highly connected datasets?
questions.why: Amazon Neptune is a fast, reliable, fully managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications that work with highly connected datasets (using property graphs or RDF).

questions.text: Which AWS machine learning service translates text from one language to another fluently and accurately?
questions.why: Amazon Translate is a neural machine translation service that delivers fast, high-quality, affordable, and customizable language translation.

questions.text: A developer needs an automated, serverless mechanism to process a CSV file immediately after it is uploaded to an S3 bucket, parse its contents, and write it to DynamoDB. Which compute service is best suited for this?
questions.why: AWS Lambda allows you to run code without provisioning servers. It natively triggers based on events in other AWS services, such as an object being created in an S3 bucket.

questions.text: A company uses several separate AWS accounts for different departments. They want to receive a single unified invoice for all the accounts at the end of the month. What feature should they use?
questions.why: Consolidated Billing is a feature of AWS Organizations that allows you to consolidate payment for multiple AWS accounts or multiple AISPL accounts into a single bill.

questions.text: A developer needs to execute code only when an object is uploaded to an Amazon S3 bucket. Which compute service is best suited for this event-driven workload?
questions.why: AWS Lambda is an event-driven, serverless compute service that runs your code in response to events (such as an S3 object upload) without provisioning or managing servers.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing model provides the lowest possible cost for EC2 instances if the workload is flexible and can be interrupted at any time?
questions.why: Spot Instances let you take advantage of unused EC2 capacity in the AWS cloud and are available at up to a 90% discount compared to On-Demand prices. They are ideal for fault-tolerant, flexible workloads.

questions.text: A business wants to run a relational database in the cloud but wants to minimize administrative tasks such as hardware provisioning, database setup, patching, and backups. Which service should they choose?

options.text: Amazon EC2 with a custom database installation

questions.why: Amazon Relational Database Service (RDS) makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale a relational database in the cloud. It automates time-consuming administrative tasks such as hardware provisioning, setup, patching, and backups.

questions.text: What is the primary function of an AWS Internet Gateway?

options.text: To route traffic between different VPCs
To provide a secure connection between an on-premises network and a VPC
To enable instances in a public subnet to connect to the public internet
To act as a firewall blocking malicious traffic

questions.why: An Internet Gateway is a horizontally scaled, redundant, and highly available VPC component that allows communication between instances in your VPC and the internet.

questions.text: Which AWS service is specifically designed for analyzing and processing massive amounts of streaming data in real time?
questions.why: Amazon Kinesis makes it easy to collect, process, and analyze real-time, streaming data so you can get timely insights and react quickly to new information.

questions.text: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, which of the following is an example of 'Security IN the Cloud' (the customer's responsibility)?

options.text: Physical security of AWS data centers
Patching the hypervisor layer of Amazon EC2
Configuring security groups for EC2 instances
Replacing faulty disk drives in the storage array

questions.why: Configuring security groups (virtual firewalls) is part of managing the guest operating system and applications, which falls under the customer's responsibility ('Security IN the Cloud').

questions.text: Which storage service provides a highly available and durable object storage solution that can store an unlimited amount of data?
questions.why: Amazon Simple Storage Service (Amazon S3) is an object storage service that offers industry-leading scalability, data availability, security, and performance. It is designed to store virtually unlimited amounts of data.

questions.text: A media company wants to distribute its video content globally with low latency and high transfer speeds. Which AWS service provides a Content Delivery Network (CDN) to achieve this?
questions.why: Amazon CloudFront is a fast content delivery network (CDN) service that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to customers globally with low latency and high transfer speeds.

questions.text: Which database service provides a fast, fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse for running complex SQL queries and analytics?
questions.why: Amazon Redshift is a fully managed, petabyte-scale data warehouse service in the cloud. It allows you to analyze data using standard SQL and your existing Business Intelligence (BI) tools.

questions.text: Which AWS security feature acts as a stateful firewall applied at the EC2 instance level?
questions.why: A Security Group acts as a virtual firewall for your EC2 instances to control inbound and outbound traffic. It operates at the instance level and is stateful (return traffic is automatically allowed).

questions.text: A developer needs to decouple different components of a distributed application by passing messages between them. Which fully managed message queuing service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon Simple Queue Service (SQS) is a fully managed message queuing service that enables you to decouple and scale microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications.

questions.text: Which AWS service helps protect your web applications from common web exploits like SQL injection and cross-site scripting (XSS)?
questions.why: AWS Web Application Firewall (WAF) helps protect your web applications or APIs against common web exploits and bots that may affect availability, compromise security, or consume excessive resources.

questions.text: Which tool provides automated recommendations to help you follow AWS best practices for cost optimization, security, performance, and fault tolerance?
questions.why: AWS Trusted Advisor is an online tool that provides you real-time guidance to help you provision your resources following AWS best practices across cost, performance, security, and fault tolerance.

questions.text: A company requires a dedicated, private physical network connection from their on-premises data center directly into the AWS cloud. Which service provides this?
questions.why: AWS Direct Connect provides a dedicated private network connection from your premises to AWS. This can reduce network costs, increase bandwidth throughput, and provide a more consistent network experience than internet-based connections.

questions.text: Which S3 storage class is best for data that is rarely accessed but requires rapid access (within milliseconds) when needed, while keeping costs low?
questions.why: S3 Standard-IA is designed for data that is accessed less frequently, but requires rapid access when needed. It offers the high durability, high throughput, and low latency of S3 Standard, with a low per GB storage price.

questions.text: According to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, 'designing for failure' and 'testing recovery procedures' are principles of which pillar?
questions.why: The Reliability pillar focuses on workloads performing their intended functions and how to recover quickly from failures to meet business and customer demand.

questions.text: An organization wants to centrally manage and govern their environment as they grow and scale their AWS resources across multiple accounts. Which service should they use to consolidate billing and apply Service Control Policies (SCPs)?
questions.why: AWS Organizations helps you centrally manage and govern your environment as you grow and scale your AWS resources. It provides consolidated billing and allows you to apply Service Control Policies (SCPs) to multiple accounts.

questions.text: Which AWS machine learning service is designed specifically to convert text into lifelike speech?
questions.why: Amazon Polly is a service that turns text into lifelike speech, allowing you to create applications that talk, and build entirely new categories of speech-enabled products.

questions.text: Which networking service allows you to register domain names, route internet traffic to your resources, and check the health of your resources?
questions.why: Amazon Route 53 is a highly available and scalable cloud Domain Name System (DNS) web service designed to route end users to internet applications by translating domain names into IP addresses.

questions.text: A developer wants to provision their infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) with templates written in YAML or JSON. Which service should they use?
questions.why: AWS CloudFormation gives you an easy way to model a collection of related AWS and third-party resources, provision them quickly and consistently, and manage them throughout their lifecycles, by treating infrastructure as code.

questions.text: Which feature of Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling allows your architecture to automatically increase or decrease the number of EC2 instances based on demand?
questions.why: Dynamic Scaling Policies within Amazon EC2 Auto Scaling allow you to automatically adjust your compute capacity based on metrics like CPU utilization or network traffic, ensuring you have the right number of instances at any time.

questions.text: Which service acts as a fully managed data security and data privacy service that uses machine learning to discover and protect sensitive data, such as Personally Identifiable Information (PII), in AWS?
questions.why: Amazon Macie is a fully managed data security and data privacy service that uses machine learning and pattern matching to discover and protect your sensitive data in Amazon S3.

questions.text: What is the primary benefit of deploying an application architecture across multiple Availability Zones?
questions.why: Deploying across multiple Availability Zones provides high availability and fault tolerance. If one AZ experiences a failure, your application can continue to run using the resources in the other AZs.

questions.text: A company wants to securely store and automatically rotate database credentials and API keys. Which AWS service is purpose-built for this task?
questions.why: AWS Secrets Manager helps you protect secrets needed to access your applications, services, and IT resources. The service enables you to easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets.

questions.text: Which cloud computing deployment model combines on-premises infrastructure with public cloud resources, allowing data and applications to be shared between them?
questions.why: A Hybrid Cloud deployment combines on-premises infrastructure (or a private cloud) with public cloud resources, allowing organizations to leverage the benefits of both environments.
questions.concept: Private vs Public vs Hybrid Cloud

questions.text: A team wants to run Docker containers in the AWS cloud but does not want to manage the underlying EC2 instances or cluster infrastructure. Which serverless compute engine should they use?
questions.why: AWS Fargate is a serverless compute engine for containers that works with both Amazon ECS and EKS. Fargate makes it easy to focus on building your applications by removing the need to provision and manage servers.

questions.text: Which service provides a centralized view of security alerts and compliance status across your AWS accounts by aggregating findings from services like GuardDuty, Macie, and Inspector?
questions.why: AWS Security Hub gives you a comprehensive view of your high-priority security alerts and security posture across your AWS accounts, automatically aggregating and organizing findings from multiple AWS services.

questions.text: To ensure that user traffic is directed to the AWS Region providing the lowest latency, which Route 53 routing policy should be configured?
questions.why: Latency Routing policy routes traffic to the AWS Region that provides the lowest latency to the end user, optimizing the application's performance globally.

questions.text: Which AWS service is used to easily create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure REST, HTTP, and WebSocket APIs at any scale?
questions.why: Amazon API Gateway is a fully managed service that makes it easy for developers to create, publish, maintain, monitor, and secure APIs at any scale, acting as the 'front door' for applications.

questions.text: A developer needs an in-memory data store to serve as a cache for a read-heavy application, reducing latency to sub-milliseconds. Which service is the best fit?
questions.why: Amazon ElastiCache allows you to seamlessly set up, run, and scale popular open-source compatible in-memory data stores (Redis or Memcached) to deliver sub-millisecond response times.

questions.text: Which migration tool helps you plan your migration to AWS by collecting usage and configuration data from your on-premises servers?
questions.why: AWS Application Discovery Service helps enterprise customers plan migration projects by gathering information about their on-premises data centers, including server utilization data and dependency mapping.

questions.text: Which AWS service enables you to set custom budgets that alert you when your costs or usage exceed (or are forecasted to exceed) your budgeted amount?
questions.why: AWS Budgets gives you the ability to set custom budgets that alert you when your costs or usage exceed (or are forecasted to exceed) your budgeted amount, helping you track your cloud spend.

questions.text: What does Amazon EBS stand for, and what type of storage does it provide?

options.text: Elastic Block Store; block-level storage for EC2 instances
Elastic Bucket Store; object storage for unlimited data
Elastic Backup Service; automated backups for databases
Enterprise Block Service; on-premises storage arrays

questions.why: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) provides highly available, consistent, low-latency block storage volumes for use with Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.text: A financial institution needs a fully managed service to track and log all user interactions and API calls made within their AWS account for compliance auditing. Which service must be enabled?
questions.why: AWS CloudTrail records AWS API calls for your account and delivers log files. This history enables security analysis, resource change tracking, and compliance auditing.

questions.text: Which AWS database service provides a fast, reliable, fully managed graph database service?
questions.why: Amazon Neptune is a fast, reliable, fully managed graph database service that makes it easy to build and run applications that work with highly connected datasets.

questions.text: According to the AWS Cloud Adoption Framework (CAF), which perspective focuses on implementing, operating, and managing IT workloads in the cloud to ensure they deliver business value?
questions.why: The Operations Perspective helps you to understand how to update the staff skills and organizational processes necessary to ensure system health and reliability during the move to the cloud and beyond.

questions.text: Which AWS network feature operates at the subnet level and acts as a stateless firewall to control inbound and outbound traffic?
questions.why: A Network Access Control List (NACL) is an optional layer of security for your VPC that acts as a firewall for controlling traffic in and out of one or more subnets. It is stateless, meaning return traffic must be explicitly allowed.

questions.text: A developer wants to quickly deploy a simple web application with a fixed monthly price and minimal configuration. Which AWS service is the most appropriate choice?
questions.why: Amazon Lightsail is an easy-to-use virtual private server (VPS) that offers you everything needed to build an application or website, plus a cost-effective, highly predictable monthly plan.

questions.text: A company has 80 Terabytes of data stored on-premises and a slow internet connection. They need to migrate this data to Amazon S3 within a week. What is the best method?

options.text: Upload over the internet using Amazon S3 Multipart Upload
Use AWS DataSync over the internet
Use an AWS Snowball Edge device
Establish an AWS Direct Connect connection

questions.why: AWS Snowball Edge is a physical data transport solution that accelerates moving terabytes to petabytes of data into and out of AWS using storage devices designed to be secure for physical transport.
questions.priorityNote: not on the CLF-C02 in-scope list

questions.text: Which AWS machine learning service enables developers to easily add image and video analysis to their applications?
questions.why: Amazon Rekognition makes it easy to add image and video analysis to your applications. You just provide an image or video to the Rekognition API, and the service can identify objects, people, text, scenes, and activities.

questions.text: Which support plan includes access to an AWS Technical Account Manager (TAM)?
questions.why: The Enterprise Support plan is the only plan that includes access to a designated Technical Account Manager (TAM) who provides proactive guidance and best practices.

questions.text: A company wants to analyze data directly from their Amazon S3 data lake using standard SQL queries without provisioning any databases or servers. Which service allows this?
questions.why: Amazon Athena is an interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. Athena is serverless, so there is no infrastructure to manage, and you pay only for the queries that you run.

questions.text: Which continuous delivery service automates your software release process, allowing you to model, visualize, and automate the steps required to release your software?
questions.why: AWS CodePipeline is a fully managed continuous delivery service that helps you automate your release pipelines for fast and reliable application and infrastructure updates.

questions.text: Which cloud characteristic ensures that cloud resources automatically scale out when demand increases and scale in when demand decreases?
questions.why: Elasticity is the ability to acquire resources as you need them and release resources when you no longer need them automatically, matching supply with demand.

questions.text: A developer needs to securely create, manage, and deploy public and private SSL/TLS certificates for use with their load balancers and CloudFront distributions. Which service should they use?
questions.why: AWS Certificate Manager (ACM) is a service that lets you easily provision, manage, and deploy public and private Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security (SSL/TLS) certificates for use with AWS services and your internal connected resources.

questions.text: An organization wants to run machine learning models at the edge of the 5G network to provide ultra-low latency for mobile applications. Which AWS infrastructure deployment option provides this?
questions.why: AWS Wavelength brings AWS services to the edge of the 5G network, minimizing the latency to connect to an application from a mobile device.

questions.text: Which service acts as a managed, cloud-based virtual desktop environment that allows remote employees to securely access their desktop from anywhere?
questions.why: Amazon WorkSpaces is a fully managed, secure Desktop-as-a-Service (DaaS) solution that helps you provision Windows or Linux desktops for your users in just a few minutes.

questions.text: To improve application performance and availability, a company wants to route user traffic over the AWS global network infrastructure instead of the public internet. Which service provides this capability?
questions.why: AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that improves the performance of your users' traffic by up to 60% using Amazon's global network infrastructure, providing static IP addresses that act as a fixed entry point to your application endpoints.

questions.text: Which cloud computing principle states that you can replace large upfront infrastructure costs with lower pay-as-you-go costs?

options.text: Trade capital expense for variable expense
Benefit from massive economies of scale

questions.why: Trading capital expense (CapEx) for variable expense (OpEx) means you pay for what you use, when you use it, instead of investing heavily in data centers before you know how you're going to use them.

questions.text: According to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, which pillar focuses on minimizing the environmental impacts of running cloud workloads?
questions.why: The Sustainability pillar focuses on environmental impacts, including reducing energy consumption and increasing efficiency across all components of a workload.

questions.text: A company wants to perform security penetration testing on their Amazon EC2 instances. What is the AWS policy regarding this?

options.text: It is strictly prohibited under all circumstances.
It is allowed, but only if performed by AWS Support.
It can be performed without prior approval for permitted services.
It requires written approval from the AWS Abuse team at least 7 days in advance.

questions.why: AWS allows customers to carry out security assessments or penetration tests against their AWS infrastructure for permitted services (like EC2, RDS, Aurora) without prior approval.

questions.text: If a user suspects that an AWS resource is being used for abusive or illegal purposes, such as sending spam or distributing malware, who should they contact?
questions.why: The AWS Trust & Safety team (AWS Abuse team) is responsible for assisting customers when AWS resources are used to engage in abusive behavior, like spam, port scanning, or malware.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing model is best suited for an application with unpredictable, spikey, but highly persistent traffic that cannot be interrupted?
questions.why: On-Demand Instances are ideal for short-term, spiky, or unpredictable workloads that cannot be interrupted. (Reserved Instances are for steady-state; Spot is for interruptible).

questions.text: An organization requires strict physical isolation of their EC2 instances on a server level due to regulatory compliance. Which purchasing option is required?
questions.why: Dedicated Hosts provide a physical server fully dedicated for your use, offering visibility and control over how instances are placed on the server, often required for strict compliance or BYOL.

questions.text: Which AWS service allows you to provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where you can launch resources in a virtual network?
questions.why: Amazon VPC lets you provision a logically isolated section of the AWS Cloud where you can launch AWS resources in a virtual network that you define and control.

questions.text: What does a subnet do within an Amazon VPC?

options.text: It connects the VPC to the public internet.
It divides the VPC into smaller network segments located within a single Availability Zone.
It encrypts data in transit between EC2 instances.
It automatically distributes traffic across multiple instances.

questions.why: A subnet is a range of IP addresses in your VPC. Subnets divide your VPC network into smaller segments and are always mapped to a single Availability Zone.

questions.text: Which tool provides automated checks, creates alerts, and provides remediation guidance for security best practices and compliance standard requirements across your AWS accounts?
questions.why: AWS Security Hub provides a comprehensive view of your security state and helps you check your environment against security industry standards and best practices (like CIS AWS Foundations).

questions.text: Which AWS service is an interactive, serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, and combine data for analytics, machine learning, and application development?
questions.why: AWS Glue is a serverless data integration service that makes it easy to discover, prepare, and combine data for analytics, machine learning, and application development (ETL processes).

questions.text: A developer wants to add user sign-up, sign-in, and access control to a mobile application using social identity providers (like Facebook or Google). Which service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon Cognito provides authentication, authorization, and user management for your web and mobile apps. It supports social identity providers natively.

questions.text: Which AWS capability allows a company to automatically distribute incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as EC2 instances, in multiple Availability Zones?
questions.why: Elastic Load Balancing (ELB) automatically distributes incoming application traffic across multiple targets, such as Amazon EC2 instances, containers, IP addresses, and Lambda functions.

questions.text: In AWS architecture, what is the concept of a 'Multi-Region' deployment primarily designed to achieve?

options.text: Disaster recovery and global high availability

questions.why: Deploying an application across multiple AWS Regions provides the highest level of disaster recovery and global high availability, protecting against the unlikely event of an entire Region failing.

questions.text: A company requires extremely low-latency, high-performance block storage to serve as the boot volume for their EC2 instances. Which storage service fits this requirement?
questions.why: Amazon Elastic Block Store (EBS) provides highly available, consistent, low-latency block storage that is primarily used as the boot and data volumes for Amazon EC2 instances.

questions.text: Which AWS database service provides a fast, scalable, fully managed time-series database optimized for IoT and operational applications?
questions.why: Amazon Timestream is a fast, scalable, and serverless time series database service for IoT and operational applications that makes it easy to store and analyze trillions of events per day.
questions.priorityNote: not on the CLF-C02 in-scope list

questions.text: An organization wants to host a static website securely over HTTPS using a custom domain name. Which combination of AWS services should they use?

options.text: Amazon S3, Amazon CloudFront, and Amazon Route 53
Amazon EC2, Elastic Load Balancing, and AWS WAF
AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Amazon RDS, and Route 53
Amazon Lightsail, AWS Fargate, and Amazon API Gateway

questions.why: S3 hosts the static files, CloudFront distributes the content globally securely via HTTPS, and Route 53 handles the custom domain name routing.

questions.text: What type of AWS infrastructure brings compute, storage, and database services closer to large population and industry centers to reduce latency?
questions.why: AWS Local Zones place compute, storage, database, and other select AWS services closer to end-users in large population and industry centers for single-digit millisecond latency.

questions.text: Which of the following is a fully managed extract, transform, and load (ETL) service used to prepare data for analytics?
questions.why: AWS Glue is a fully managed, serverless ETL (extract, transform, and load) service that makes it simple and cost-effective to categorize your data, clean it, enrich it, and move it reliably between various data stores.

questions.text: Which service enables you to automate the deployment, scaling, and management of containerized applications using the Kubernetes ecosystem?
questions.why: Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) gives you the flexibility to start, run, and scale Kubernetes applications in the AWS cloud or on-premises.

questions.text: A developer needs to rapidly build, test, and deploy applications using a predefined platform like Node.js or Python without provisioning the underlying servers. Which service acts as a PaaS?
questions.why: AWS Elastic Beanstalk is an easy-to-use platform as a service (PaaS) for deploying and scaling web applications developed with Java, .NET, PHP, Node.js, Python, Ruby, Go, and Docker.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing model lets you save on compute usage across EC2, Fargate, and Lambda by committing to a specific amount of usage ($/hour) for a 1- or 3-year term?
questions.why: Savings Plans trade a 1- or 3-year $/hour commitment for lower prices than On-Demand. Compute Savings Plans cover EC2, Fargate, and Lambda for up to 66% off; EC2 Instance Savings Plans go up to 72% off but only apply to EC2 in one instance family and Region.

questions.text: Under the AWS Shared Responsibility Model, who is responsible for managing the encryption of data at rest in Amazon S3?

options.text: It is not possible to encrypt data at rest in S3

questions.why: The Customer is responsible for 'Security IN the Cloud', which includes classifying their data and enabling encryption at rest for services like Amazon S3 and EBS.

questions.text: Which AWS service is designed to mitigate large-scale Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) attacks automatically?
questions.why: AWS Shield is a managed Distributed Denial of Service (DDoS) protection service that safeguards applications running on AWS. Shield Standard is automatically enabled for all AWS customers at no extra cost.

questions.text: A business wants to send email notifications to a million subscribers simultaneously. Which fully managed pub/sub messaging service is designed for high-throughput, push-based delivery?
questions.why: Amazon Simple Notification Service (SNS) is a fully managed pub/sub messaging service that enables you to decouple microservices, distributed systems, and serverless applications, and send push notifications/emails.

questions.text: To ensure fault tolerance, a database must automatically fail over to a standby replica in a different physical data center if the primary fails. How should this be configured in Amazon RDS?
questions.why: Amazon RDS Multi-AZ deployments provide high availability and failover support for DB instances by automatically provisioning and maintaining a synchronous standby replica in a different Availability Zone.

questions.text: Which service allows you to model and visually manage the workflow of modern applications using state machines?
questions.why: AWS Step Functions is a low-code visual workflow service used to orchestrate AWS services, automate business processes, and build serverless applications using state machines.

questions.text: Which storage service acts as a file system that can be seamlessly mounted by both on-premises data center servers and AWS EC2 instances simultaneously over AWS Direct Connect?
questions.why: Amazon Elastic File System (EFS) is a fully managed NFS file system that can be accessed by EC2 instances in multiple AZs as well as on-premises servers via AWS Direct Connect or VPN.

questions.text: A developer needs an automated mechanism to find software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposures on their Amazon EC2 instances. Which service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon Inspector is an automated vulnerability management service that continually scans AWS workloads (like EC2 instances and container images) for software vulnerabilities and unintended network exposure.

questions.text: A company wants to identify and manage the root causes of their cloud costs by breaking down expenses by project and environment. What should they use?
questions.why: Cost Allocation Tags allow you to assign metadata to your AWS resources. You can then use the AWS Billing Console to organize your resource costs on your cost allocation report based on these tags.

questions.text: What is the key difference between AWS IAM Policies and AWS Organizations Service Control Policies (SCPs)?

options.text: IAM Policies grant permissions; SCPs encrypt data.
IAM Policies apply to regions; SCPs apply globally.
IAM Policies grant explicit permissions to users/roles; SCPs set a maximum permission boundary for an entire AWS account.
There is no difference; they are the same.

questions.why: SCPs do not grant permissions; they set a boundary (guardrails) on the maximum available permissions for all IAM users and roles within an account in AWS Organizations. IAM Policies actually grant the permissions.

questions.text: Which service tracks user activity and API usage across your AWS infrastructure, enabling operational and risk auditing?
questions.why: AWS CloudTrail enables governance, compliance, and operational and risk auditing of your AWS account by recording actions taken by a user, role, or an AWS service.

questions.text: Which of the following acts as an automated security capability that continuously monitors for malicious activity and unauthorized behavior to protect your AWS accounts?
questions.why: Amazon GuardDuty is an intelligent threat detection service that continuously monitors your AWS accounts, workloads, and data for malicious activity and delivers detailed security findings.

questions.text: A company needs a robust, scalable data lake architecture. Which AWS service is fundamentally used as the core storage layer for a data lake?
questions.why: Amazon S3 is the foundational storage layer for AWS Data Lakes due to its virtually unlimited scalability, high durability, and seamless integration with analytical tools like Athena, Glue, and Redshift.

questions.text: A developer needs to securely store, retrieve, and automatically rotate database passwords for an application. Which AWS service should be used?
questions.why: While Parameter Store can store passwords, AWS Secrets Manager is specifically built to easily rotate, manage, and retrieve database credentials, API keys, and other secrets through their lifecycle.

questions.text: According to the AWS Cloud Value Framework, which benefit highlights the reduction in the time required to provision infrastructure from weeks to minutes?
questions.why: Business agility allows organizations to react quickly to market changes, deploying new applications instantly and failing fast without wasting large upfront capital on hardware.

questions.text: Which tool acts as an interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL?
questions.why: Amazon Athena is a serverless, interactive query service that makes it easy to analyze data in Amazon S3 using standard SQL. There is no infrastructure to manage, and you pay only for the queries you run.

questions.text: Which AWS pricing tool helps customers estimate the cost savings of migrating their current on-premises data center workloads to AWS?
questions.why: Migration Evaluator (formerly TCO Calculator) provides a business case to make sound financial decisions for AWS cloud migration by comparing on-premises costs with estimated AWS costs.

questions.text: What is the main function of AWS CloudFormation?

options.text: To visualize the network traffic in a VPC
To automatically apply OS security patches to EC2 instances
To deploy and manage infrastructure using code (IaC)
To act as a central repository for application source code

questions.why: AWS CloudFormation allows you to use programming languages or simple text files (JSON/YAML) to model and provision all the resources needed for your applications across all regions and accounts in a safe, repeatable manner.

questions.text: Which service acts as a hybrid cloud storage service that gives you on-premises access to virtually unlimited cloud storage?
questions.why: AWS Storage Gateway is a hybrid cloud storage service that connects your existing on-premises environments with the AWS Cloud, providing local caching for low-latency access to data backed by S3, Glacier, or EBS.

questions.text: A developer needs to create a fast, scalable, and highly available NoSQL document database. Which AWS service provides a fully managed MongoDB-compatible database?
questions.why: Amazon DocumentDB (with MongoDB compatibility) is a fast, reliable, and fully managed database service that makes it easy to set up, operate, and scale MongoDB-compatible databases in the cloud.

questions.text: Which support plan is required if a company wants access to the AWS Support API to automate support case management?
questions.why: Access to the AWS Support API (for programmatic case management and Trusted Advisor access) requires either a Business, Enterprise On-Ramp, or Enterprise Support plan.

questions.text: Which AWS machine learning service is designed to extract text, handwriting, and data from scanned documents?
questions.why: Amazon Textract is a machine learning service that automatically extracts printed text, handwriting, and other data from scanned documents, going beyond simple optical character recognition (OCR).

questions.text: A company wants to securely process highly sensitive data by encrypting it with a hardware security module that they completely control and manage. Which service provides this?
questions.why: AWS CloudHSM provides a cloud-based hardware security module (HSM) that enables you to easily generate and use your own encryption keys. Unlike KMS, CloudHSM provides dedicated single-tenant access.

questions.text: In Amazon S3, what mechanism can you use to ensure that a deleted object can be recovered?
questions.why: S3 Versioning keeps multiple variants of an object in the same bucket. If you delete an object, S3 inserts a delete marker, but the previous version is retained and can be restored.

questions.text: Which AWS capability allows a user to run code in response to HTTP requests via API Gateway without provisioning a server?
questions.why: AWS Lambda allows you to run code without provisioning or managing servers. It integrates natively with Amazon API Gateway to create fully serverless REST or HTTP APIs.

questions.text: Which component is required to allow resources in a private VPC subnet to access the public internet for software updates, while keeping them protected from inbound internet requests?
questions.why: A NAT (Network Address Translation) Gateway allows instances in a private subnet to connect to the internet (for outbound traffic) but prevents the internet from initiating a connection with those instances.

questions.text: Which service gives you access to a central portal where you can find AWS security and compliance reports, such as SOC, PCI, and ISO certifications?
questions.why: AWS Artifact is a self-service portal for on-demand access to AWS' compliance reports. It is the central resource for compliance-related information.

questions.text: Which global AWS service acts as a fast content delivery network (CDN) that caches content at edge locations to reduce latency?
questions.why: Amazon CloudFront is a Content Delivery Network (CDN) that securely delivers data, videos, applications, and APIs to customers globally with low latency by caching content at edge locations.

questions.text: A developer needs an automated process to assess their AWS resources for cost optimization, security, and performance. Which of the following provides real-time guidance based on AWS best practices?
questions.why: AWS Trusted Advisor is an online tool that acts like your customized cloud expert, helping you provision your resources by analyzing your account against best practices in Cost Optimization, Security, Fault Tolerance, Performance, and Service Limits.

questions.text: According to the AWS Well-Architected Framework, 'democratizing advanced technologies' is a design principle for which pillar?
questions.why: Democratizing advanced technologies (making it easy to consume technologies as a service, like Machine Learning or NoSQL databases, without needing your own experts) is a core principle of the Performance Efficiency pillar.

questions.text: Which service uses machine learning to continuously monitor your cost and usage to detect unusual cloud spending?
questions.why: AWS Cost Anomaly Detection uses advanced machine learning to identify anomalous spend and root causes, minimizing the risk of billing surprises.

questions.text: A mobile app needs to allow users to sign in using their Facebook account and then obtain temporary AWS credentials to directly access an S3 bucket. Which Amazon Cognito feature is required?
questions.why: Cognito Identity Pools (Federated Identities) allow you to create unique identities for your users and federate them with identity providers. They exchange the provider token for temporary, limited-privilege AWS credentials.

questions.text: Which IAM feature is used to set the maximum permissions that an identity-based policy can grant to an IAM entity (user or role)?
questions.why: A permissions boundary is an advanced IAM feature that sets the maximum permissions an identity-based policy can grant to an IAM entity. It does not grant permissions on its own.

questions.text: What is the standard retrieval time for data stored in the Amazon S3 Glacier Deep Archive storage class?
questions.why: S3 Glacier Deep Archive is the lowest-cost storage class in AWS. Because it is designed for long-term retention (like magnetic tape backups), standard retrieval times are typically within 12 hours.

questions.text: A mission-critical database requires sustained, guaranteed performance of 64,000 IOPS. Which EBS volume type is best suited for this?
questions.why: Provisioned IOPS SSD (io1/io2) volumes are designed for latency-sensitive transactional workloads that require sustained, high IOPS performance (up to 256,000 IOPS on io2 Block Express).

questions.text: Which Route 53 routing policy allows you to route traffic based on the physical distance between your users and your resources, and allows you to optionally shift traffic using a numerical bias?
questions.why: Geoproximity routing routes traffic based on the geographic location of your users and your AWS resources. You can also optionally choose to route more traffic or less to a given resource by specifying a bias value.

questions.text: You need to securely access Amazon S3 from a private subnet without data traversing the public internet. You also want this connection to be completely free of hourly charges. What should you use?
questions.why: Gateway VPC Endpoints provide reliable connectivity to Amazon S3 and DynamoDB without requiring an internet gateway or a NAT device, and they are provided at no additional charge.

questions.text: Which service allows you to securely manage your EC2 instances without the need to open inbound ports, maintain bastion hosts, or manage SSH keys?
questions.why: AWS Systems Manager Session Manager provides a fully managed, secure, and auditable interactive browser-based or CLI-based shell access to EC2 instances without opening inbound ports (like SSH 22).

questions.text: Which feature of Amazon Redshift allows you to run complex analytical queries against exabytes of unstructured data directly in Amazon S3 without loading it into Redshift?
questions.why: Amazon Redshift Spectrum is a feature of Redshift that allows you to directly query and analyze data in Amazon S3 without having to extract, transform, and load (ETL) it into Redshift tables.

questions.text: A development environment has intermittent and unpredictable database workloads that sometimes sit idle for days. Which database configuration is the most cost-effective?
questions.why: Amazon Aurora Serverless is an on-demand, auto-scaling configuration for Aurora. It automatically starts up, shuts down, and scales capacity up or down based on your application's needs, saving costs during idle periods.

questions.text: A gaming company experiences heavy read traffic on a DynamoDB table and needs to reduce response times from milliseconds to microseconds. Which feature provides this caching?
questions.why: Amazon DynamoDB Accelerator (DAX) is a fully managed, highly available, in-memory cache for Amazon DynamoDB that delivers up to a 10x performance improvement (from milliseconds to microseconds).

questions.text: You have a legacy application on an EC2 instance that takes a long time to boot up into memory. You want to pause the instance and quickly resume it later with the RAM state intact to save costs. Which feature should you use?
questions.why: Amazon EC2 Hibernate allows you to pause your instance and save its in-memory state (RAM) to your EBS root volume. When you start the instance again, it quickly resumes from where it left off.

questions.text: How can a security engineer ensure that AWS CloudTrail log files have not been modified, deleted, or forged after CloudTrail delivered them to an S3 bucket?

options.text: Enable CloudTrail log file integrity validation
Encrypt the logs with AWS KMS

questions.why: CloudTrail log file integrity validation creates a digitally signed digest file containing a hash of each log. This mathematically proves whether a log file was changed or deleted after CloudTrail delivered it.

questions.text: Which service enables developers and engineers to easily and efficiently run hundreds of thousands of batch computing jobs on AWS without manually configuring the computing clusters?
questions.why: AWS Batch dynamically provisions the optimal quantity and type of compute resources based on the specific requirements of the batch jobs submitted, eliminating the need to install and manage batch computing software.

questions.text: A software vendor wants to stream their desktop application to users via a web browser without the users needing to install the application or provision a full virtual desktop. Which service should they use?
questions.why: Amazon AppStream 2.0 is a non-persistent application and desktop streaming service. It centrally manages desktop applications and securely delivers them to any computer via a browser. (WorkSpaces provides persistent, full virtual desktops).

questions.text: While both services improve performance, which service is explicitly designed to improve the global performance of a wide range of applications over TCP or UDP by providing two static IP addresses?
questions.why: AWS Global Accelerator is a networking service that routes traffic over the AWS global network using static IP addresses. Unlike CloudFront (which is an HTTP/HTTPS CDN), Global Accelerator supports both TCP and UDP protocols (gaming, IoT, VoIP).

questions.text: Which open-source framework allows developers to build serverless applications on AWS using shorthand syntax to express functions, APIs, and databases?
questions.why: The AWS Serverless Application Model (SAM) is an open-source framework used to build serverless applications. It uses a shorthand syntax to express functions, APIs, databases, and event source mappings, which compiles into CloudFormation.

questions.text: Which premium support service comes with a 24x7 DDoS Response Team (DRT) to assist you during large-scale network attacks?
questions.why: AWS Shield Advanced provides expanded DDoS attack protection for web applications. Crucially, it includes 24x7 access to the AWS DDoS Response Team (DRT) to help mitigate complex attacks.

questions.text: Which developer tool provides a cloud-based integrated development environment (IDE) that lets you write, run, and debug your code with just a browser, and allows for real-time pair programming?
questions.why: AWS Cloud9 is a cloud-based IDE that lets you write, run, and debug your code with just a browser. It includes a code editor, debugger, and terminal, and allows you to share your environment for real-time pair programming.
questions.priorityNote: closed to new customers, not on the in-scope list

questions.text: A hospital needs to regularly copy petabytes of on-premises file data to AWS for analysis and then immediately copy the results back. The transfer must happen over their Direct Connect link at high speeds. Which service is optimized for this task?
questions.why: AWS DataSync is an online data transfer service that simplifies, automates, and accelerates copying large amounts of data between on-premises storage and AWS over the internet or Direct Connect.
